name: HCA Information Technology & Services Data Center

profile.address: 2974, Old Franklin Road, Nashville, Davidson County, Middle Tennessee, Tennessee, 37013
profile.reading:
HCA Healthcare, the Nashville-based hospital and healthcare services company, built this facility as a purpose-built enterprise data center for its national network of hospitals and outpatient facilities. The project moved through Nashville's standard economic-incentive process for large capital investments in Davidson County: Metro Council approved a payment-in-lieu-of-taxes (PILOT) agreement for the project in March 2012 under Ordinance BL2012-116, tied to a declared capital investment of $200 million and a commitment to add 155 new jobs. By the end of 2016, employment tied to the incentive had grown to 834 positions, well beyond the original pledge, reflecting how central the site became to HCA's back-office and clinical-systems operations.

Construction was handled as a design-build partnership between DPR Construction and the architecture and engineering firm PageSoutherlandPage (Page), both of whom had worked with HCA for more than fifteen years on prior projects, including roughly $200 million in earlier data center work for the company in Texas. A building permit for the Nashville project was issued in August 2012, with substantial completion targeted for June 2013. The finished building totals about 100,000 square feet, of which roughly 30,000 to 38,000 square feet is raised-floor computer room space, plus about 10,000 square feet of office area. Power infrastructure includes a 12-megawatt capacity system built around a tri-bus 15-kilovolt switchgear arrangement with automatic transfer capability, backed by N+1 diesel generators with 24-hour on-site fuel storage and distributed underground to critical loads. The design also incorporated unfinished "warm shell" space intended for future expansion without new ground-up construction, and the building achieved LEED-NC (New Construction) green-building certification.

The facility sits in the Antioch section of southeast Davidson County, in the same 37013 zip code corridor as several other large corporate and logistics buildings; Metro's own incentive filings associate the project with a Crossings Boulevard address in the same business park referenced by this listing's Old Franklin Road location, and a Parcel ID of 17400003200. As is typical for a healthcare company's internal infrastructure, HCA has not published operational details such as current utilization, tenant mix, or a public tour program. This is a private, single-tenant corporate facility supporting the company's own IT and clinical-systems operations rather than a commercial colocation site marketed to outside customers, which is why the technical specifications published for it stop at what the permitting and incentive process required the company to disclose.

reading.body:
HCA Information Technology & Services Data Center is located in Nashville, Davidson County, Tennessee. The operator has not published specifications for power capacity, floor space, or IT load. Research found no facility-specific detail on the operator's corporate site or other public sources, suggesting this is a private internal data center rather than a marketed commercial facility.

Tennessee has 24 mapped data center facilities, but only 4 publish power capacity figures totaling 12.13 MW. This campus ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state, though that ranking reflects the state of Tennessee's overall limited published disclosure rather than absolute facility size.

Without published power specifications, the capacity and architectural significance of this facility cannot be assessed. The absence of published detail is consistent with operation as a private corporate facility rather than participation in the infrastructure market that shapes AI scaling decisions.
